title: Adding Initial Inventory via Opening Stock Batches

intro.title: Opening Stock Batches
intro.subtitle: Recording existing shelf stock, batch numbers, expiry dates, purchase rates (PTR), and initial inventory valuation

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 4, Part 4: Adding Initial Inventory via Opening Stock Batches. When onboarding your pharmacy, existing shelf items must be recorded into traceable batches.
Navigate to Batches from the Inventory menu and click Opening Stock to record shelf inventory already physically present in your store.
Select the item from your master catalog. MediFlow automatically loads the generic composition, pack size, and default price parameters.
Input the physical batch number printed on the packaging, specify the manufacturing expiry date, enter unit quantity, and record the purchase rate.
Click Record Stock to commit the batch. Your inventory valuation updates instantly, and the batch is ready for auto-FEFO dispensing. Next: Bulk CSV Import.

outro.takeaway: Opening Stock: Capture initial physical inventory into audited batches with expiry dates and purchase rates to establish accurate baseline stock valuation.
